newsitem.title: GERMANY: Audi to assemble luxury cars in Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Audi to assemble luxury cars in Philippines.

text.p: German luxury carmaker Audi AG, a unit of Volkswagen AG, said on Monday that it would assemble vehicles for the Asian market at a plant in the Philippines with partner Proton Philipinas Corp.
Audi said the plant would produce A4 and A6 luxury saloons. The licensing contract for the plant, which runs through the year 2000, calls for more than 2,000 of the vehicles to be assembled.
Audi said the growth in the Asian markets prompted the deal. The new plant in Manila will be the fifth foreign site for the Ingolstadt-based carmaker.
